name: Pine-Felling Axe (Phạt Tùng Phủ)
lore: A woodcutter's axe of Tùng Hạ Thị with a haft of fallen pine, the only wood the Lâm carvers of Lộc Minh will cut. Lâm Dã Hạc's father felled pines with it for the market for forty years; it held the Tùng Hạ road on the three nights of 1190 (A064), and a wolf's tooth is still in the haft.
build_use: A body cultivator's weapon: attack, health and a body shield.
made_by: a smith of Tùng Hạ Thị
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Old Bronze Lamp (Cổ Đồng Đăng)
lore: A temple lamp of green bronze dug out of the ice of Lẫm Đông Thành (V079) by Phàn Cổ Đăng when she was a girl. It has burned on seal fat for 180 years and has never gone out in a ruin. Thiệu Tàn Đăng carried its twin into Băng Hỏa Môn's fire hall in 1171 (N-loose_north-01); that one went out.
build_use: Soul sense and resistances for a digger who must see a ward before it sees her.
made_by: unknown (a temple of Lẫm Đông Thành)

name: Lynx-Bone Axe (Linh Miêu Cốt Phủ)
lore: One of two woodsmen's axes the old chief Tề Đoản Vĩ re-hafted in the shin bones of a lynx for the two boys he raised on the Bobtail ridge. Its twin is the Bobtail Axe Triều Ngũ Lang carried into the mist in 1081 (N-vu_an-02). Khấu Thiên Tứ has kept the edge and the old chief's notches on the haft, and added none of his own.
build_use: Wood attack, crit damage and leech for a fighter with no healer.

name: Thawing Brazier (Giải Băng Lô)
lore: A copper censer from a Tống Khách Thị stall that Phàn Cổ Đăng bought Dư Chúc Nhi in 1195 with the Scorch Fist Primer. The girl cut its vents wider herself so it would burn hotter.
build_use: A small Fire attack and linh lực recovery for a Luyện Khí fist fighter.
made_by: a coppersmith of Tống Khách Thị

name: Bark-Hide Vest (Thụ Bì Giáp)
lore: Pine bark laced over elk hide by his mother; it has been split by three axes and stitched three times.
build_use: Wood's health and recovery under the iron bones.
made_by: his mother, a woodcutter's wife of the pine sea

name: Ring of the Bobtail Chief (Đoản Vĩ Trại Hoàn)
lore: An iron ring passed from chief to chief of the Bobtail band; each chief files a notch in it, and there are nine.

name: Ember Pendant (Hỏa Tẫn Bội)
lore: A live coal from the brazier sealed in a glass bead by the crew's lamp-boss; it is warm to the touch in any frost.
build_use: Hot fists, for the day she can wear two things.
